# Position Specific Training

Training matters. A trained leader can do it easier and then it becomes more fun.

There is required training for all of those in any kind of leadership positions like Council President, Cubmasters/Scoutmasters, Merit Badge Counselors, Chartering Organization Representatives, Youth leaders of National Youth Leadership Program, and more!

Are you a participant in Scouting America in one of the following categories? 
Learn more about the correct training for you in the links below:

- [Chartered Organization Representative](charteredorgrep.qmd)
- [Cub Scouts](cubsreqsbyposition.qmd)
- [Merit Badge Counselor](meritbadgecounselor.qmd)
- [Scouts BSA](troopreqsbyposition.qmd)
- [Venturing](venturereqsbyposition.qmd)
